chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washa', from Aban, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

'When the woman sees the yellowness before the passing of her numbered days (of menstruation), she should not pray (salat); and if the yellowness was after the passing of her days of purity, she should pray (salat).'

key_terms.أَيَّام عِدَّة: The numbered/counted days — referring to the known habitual days of a woman's menstrual period
key_terms.أَيَّام قُرْء: Days of purity (tuhr) — the clean period between two menstrual cycles; qur' here means the cycle of purity
key_terms.الصُّفْرَة: Yellowness/saffron-colored discharge — a type of discharge associated with the end of or immediately after menstruation; its ruling differs based on its timing relative to the menstrual period
key_terms.لَمْ تُصَلِّ: She should not pray — prohibition of salat due to menstrual impurity (haydh)

ai.seo_question: Does yellowish discharge before the end of the menstrual period count as menstruation in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a jurisprudential ruling on menstrual purity: yellowish discharge seen before the end of the menstrual period counts as part of the haydh (menstruation) and prohibits salat. However, yellowish discharge seen after the menstrual period has ended counts as beyond haydh and does not prohibit salat. This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that the status of discharge depends on whether it occurs within or outside the known menstrual days.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Ismail Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the woman sees the yellowness before the passing of her numbered days, she should not pray Salaat; and if the yellowness was after the passing of her days of purity, she should pray Salaat’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from ’Isma‘il al-Ju‘fiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a woman experiences a discharge of yellowish color within the (normal) time period of her Hayd (menses), she must not perform Salah (prayer); but if it is after the period of Hayd-free time she must perform Salah (prayer).”’
